NO8D practical integration notes
widgets_values: Flux Klein 9B NO8D practical integration (v3). The two arch Random Reference Image Source nodes remain the active source and reference selectors. Import a bundled XLSX in the NO8D prompt-library node, then select one card; the safe empty state contributes no text until then. The NO8D LoRA stack is model-only and starts empty; trigger words merge into the final positive prompt automatically. NO8D Prompt-view is in auto mode and may be switched to edit mode for manual review. The A/B node compares the scaled primary source (A) with the generated result (B). The existing metadata saver remains active. The NO8D dataset saver is connected but disabled to avoid duplicate files; enable it only when paired image/caption export is wanted. Flux2Scheduler and SamplerCustomAdvanced remain authoritative—NO8D-Generate is intentionally not used.
